confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are triangulated from several Wellington guides and venue menus, so they are moderately reliable. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain: they come from aggregator estimates and a few dated menus, and cocktails and wine vary widely by venue. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Wellington's lodging market, not from live listings. The midrange_meal_2p source figures conflict (NZ$60-90 per person for three courses vs. about NZ$80 for two), so the anchor reflects the per-person figure. The FX rate was taken from search-result reporting of the RBA 4.00 pm observation for 2026-11-18; I did not open the RBA page directly. The NZD-to-USD conversion used for the drink and meal anchors assumes about 0.60 USD per NZD, which was not verified by search.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Wellington-specific guide estimates and venue menus, cross-checked against each other. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for Wellington from general knowledge and the city context, not from a comparable city.
